---
title: "Team Members"
format: html
---

Meet the people participating in the Glider Rodeo Hackathon.

## Information to provide

To add your card, please provide:

- your preferred name and pronouns (optional)
- your role on the team
- your organization or affiliation
- a short biography (one or two sentences)
- a headshot or other square image, plus a brief description for the image's alternative text
- links you would like to share, such as GitHub, an organization profile, or a personal website

Images should be placed in `hackathon/images/team/`. A square image at least 400 × 400 pixels works best.

## Card template

Copy the outer column and card below into the card grid in this page. Replace every value in brackets and remove any links or fields that do not apply.

````markdown
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
![Brief description of the team member](images/team/[image-file.jpg]){.card-img-top}

::: {.card-body}
### [Preferred name]

**[Role]**  
[Organization or affiliation]

[One- or two-sentence biography.]

[[GitHub](https://github.com/[username])] · [[Profile or website](https://example.org)]
:::
:::
:::
````
